instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: MVNO (Mobile Virtual Network Operator) reselling mobile voice and data plans targeting the youth and digital-native segment. 80,000 active subscribers acquired primarily through digital channels. Seeking to differentiate through app-based plan customization and AI-driven usage optimization recommendations. We operate across multiple locations and have distinct functional leadership for operations, commercial, finance, and technology. Our annual planning process is well-established but can be rigid — mid-cycle innovation funding requires navigating a formal business case approval chain involving 3-4 stakeholders.
answers.pastInitiatives: We attempted to introduce a weekly innovation brainstorming session across departments, but attendance dropped rapidly after the first month. Participants felt the sessions generated interesting ideas but had no clear path to execution or budget. The initiative faded without producing any tangible outcome.
answers.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. This requires us to expand our addressable market, potentially pivot pricing models from one-time to recurring revenue, and build a repeatable enterprise sales motion. We need to identify the highest-leverage growth levers without overextending our cash runway.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.
answers.additionalContext: We completed a merger with a similarly-sized competitor 4 months ago and are in the middle of integrating teams, systems, and processes. The combined organization has significant duplication — two CRMs, two HR systems, overlapping product lines. There is a unique window to redesign processes from scratch rather than patching legacy approaches, but cultural integration is fragile and change fatigue is real.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 2 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: Post-Merger Operational Blueprinting & Synergy Capture
opportunities.rationale: The merger presents a unique, time-sensitive window to redesign duplicated processes (CRM, HR) from scratch rather than patching legacy systems. This radical overhaul is critical for achieving the €50M ARR target by creating scalable, integrated operational blueprints that eliminate current friction and capture lost synergies.

first_actions: Form a cross-functional Integration Steering Committee (ISC) with executive sponsorship.
Conduct process mapping workshops focused on 'Future State' workflows rather than documenting 'As Is' states.
Prioritize 1-2 core revenue-critical processes (e.g., billing, onboarding) for immediate blueprinting.
resources_needed: Executive sponsorship and dedicated time from functional leads
execution_plan.success_metric: Deployment of the 'Future State' workflow for the top 3 revenue processes.
milestones: High-Level Future State Blueprint approved by leadership (Month 2)
Pilot implementation in a sandbox environment (Month 4)

opportunities.title: Productized B2B Service Offering Development
opportunities.rationale: To achieve €50M ARR, the company must move beyond reactive service sales. Leveraging existing app/AI capabilities and product squads, developing packaged, repeatable solutions for mid-market enterprise clients will build a reliable, scalable revenue stream necessary for sustainable growth.

first_actions: Identify 3 core pain points within the complementary business units (e.g., IoT fleet management, customized employee connectivity).
Use the existing '20% time' policy to dedicate initial technical sprints to designing minimum viable products (MVPs) for these offerings.
Align the commercial team with product leadership to define necessary pricing models (subscription/usage-based).
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 3 pilot paying B2B clients using the new productized service.
milestones: Market research and offering definition complete (Month 1.5)
Signed Letter of Intent with a target enterprise client (Month 6)

next_steps.action: Establish the Integration Steering Committee (ISC) and define its governance charter to legitimize process redesign efforts.
Hold cross-functional workshops focused on mapping desired 'Future State' customer journey touchpoints, linking technical capacity to commercial goals.
Re-evaluate the '20% time' policy output by requiring every self-directed project to have a clear, preliminary B2B commercial value proposition attached.

key_weaknesses: Fragile cultural integration post-merger, leading to change fatigue and resistance to process standardization.
Over-reliance on reactive services rather than scalable, productized B2B offerings required for high ARR targets.
Lack of a single source of truth (data/process) due to duplicated legacy systems.

improvements: Successful launch and progress on Inventory digitalization project (Supply Chain maturity).
Formalization of dedicated innovation time ('20% policy') and structured pitch mechanisms.
Increased operational visibility into merged entity structure (despite duplication issues).
persistent_gaps: The core organizational processes remain fragmented, hindering true synergy realization.
Middle management remains resistant to major structural changes due to the merger stress.
Formal customer feedback mechanisms are still informal and unquantified.
achieved_milestones: Completion of previous optimization/planning goals (Opp 1, Opp 2).
Commitment from technology squads to dedicated self-directed innovation time.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant maturity jump due to structured innovation processes ('20% time') and digital project launches (Inventory). However, the recent merger has introduced massive complexity risks, shifting focus from pure optimization to critical organizational re-engineering.
